proof: `ARTICLE 20 ... FY 2012 Omnibus Budget`, PDF pages 84-85 of the FY2011 annual town report (printed folios 81-82). THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM: `Line No.` | `Account` | `VOTED FY 2012`. This is the budget the 2011 annual town meeting VOTED for FY2012, printed inside the FY2011 report, so it is a single money column and not an appropriated/expended schedule. THIS FILE IS ONE PRINTED SECTION of it: `the whole article, from its eleven printed section totals`, footed to its own printed `TOTAL OMNIBUS BUDGET` row, which is the identity the page states about this block. THE IDENTITY THAT CLOSES BOTH PAGES AT ONCE: the eleven printed section totals, four from page 84 and seven from page 85, sum to the printed `TOTAL OMNIBUS BUDGET` of 26,582,151.74 EXACTLY, no tolerance. Every one of those eleven is itself footed to its own line items in its own file, so a single wrong digit anywhere in the 83 printed lines of this article breaks either a section total or this one. WHAT THE ARTICLE'S OWN PROSE STATES, AND HOW IT RELATES: the vote above the table reads `VOTED to raise and appropriate $25,674,298.74, transfer $10,872.00 from Septic Receipts Reserved for Appropriation, transfer $30,715.00 from Sewer Enterprise Fund, transfer $803,485.00 from the Sewer Betterment Fund and transfer $62,781.00 from the Water Betterment Fund`. Those five figures sum to 26,582,151.74 -- the same total, by a different route, stated in words rather than in the table. That is a SIXTH independent printing of the quantity and it is also rule 11 in the town's own hand: the omnibus budget is not all raised from the levy, and $907,853.00 of it comes from four named funds. `$ -` IS AN EXPLICIT ZERO here, not a missing figure -- it is what the sheet prints for a line voted at nothing -- and it is recorded as 0.00. Rows are keyed on the PRINTED LINE NUMBER, which is unique down the page; where the sheet prints no usable line number the printed characters are used verbatim as the key rather than a number being supplied. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: that the town spent any of it. These are voted FY2012 appropriations, and CLAUDE.md rule 1 forbids differencing them against the FY2011 actual-side columns on pages 60-65 of the same report.
